messages:
tanvi: Quick heads-up: planning a small runtime rootfs refresh next week to drop leftover setuid helpers and enable uidshift-by-default. Two quick questions: 1) does the image-signer service account need RBAC changes to talk to KMS? we currently give kms.keys.get + storage.objectViewer. 2) will uidshift break any sidecars that assume root mounts?

alex: For signing you really only need sign permission on the KMS key (kms.cryptoSign / cloudkms.sign). Avoid giving decrypt. kms.get is usually separate, but signer role can include it. storage.objectViewer is fine for registry reads.

sarah: Agreed. Make the signer SA least-privilege: only key signer role, not key admin. Also scope it per-environment.

tanvi: Follow-ups: a) our infra automation fetches key metadata via `kms.get` to read key version - does signer role usually allow that? b) any runtime caveats when uidshift flips on?

alex: a) often yes but double-check IAM bundle. b) uidshift will cause containers that expect root-owned paths (eg /var/run, some init sidecars) to lose write perms. Recommend full staging run with same FUSE and PVC mounts.

miguel: FYI last rebuild we lost provenance links because signing ran concurrently with bake/push. Can we gate sign until after push ack + artifact metadata uploaded?

eva: Proposal: make signing explicit after push with an artifact lock step in the pipeline. Example snippet: `push -> wait_for:push -> sign --key $KMS_KEY $ARTIFACT` to avoid races.

opsbot: Pipeline 4832: push completed for runtime/base:2026-03-15-rc4. Signing queued. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jen: From audit side: registry will show cosign entries but KMS key usage details require KMS audit export enabled to our log bucket. Without export we won't see key resource in central logs.

sarah: Add preflight checklist entries: `kms_audit_export == enabled` and `signer_sa limited to signer role`. Also prefer per-env signer SAs and per-env keys so we can revoke per-env.

tanvi: I'll update the RFC and checklist. Can someone review RBAC if I open a PR?

sarah: I'll take RBAC review this afternoon.

eva: I'll open the pipeline PR with the wait-for step and lock the artifact tag before sign.

miguel: I'll schedule a staging canary bake tomorrow 10am PT if approvals land.

jen: Approved for staging canary provided KMS audit export is configured and pipeline uses artifact lock.

tanvi: Thanks — will post RFC link here once updated. :thumbsup:
